content.comment_body: Hello, I have a Lambda TDK power supply and need to control the analog output of an [product_name] AM2 AQ module. There is nothing connected to the input (no sensor, no potentiometer), and I want to create a program to set the analog output voltage between 0 and 10 V. Can you please assist?
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. This is an English speaking forum. Please post your future messages in English. Thank you.
Closed because the question was posted twice. The duplicate thread with subject 'Drive the AM2 AQ output' is published under [product_name] - Software. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user seeks to control the analog output of an [product_name] module, aiming for a voltage range of 0-10V, using a Lambda TDK power supply and no input devices. The main challenge is programming the output module to achieve the desired voltage. This highlights a need for clearer documentation or programming examples for similar use cases.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to programmatically generate a 0-10V analog output directly from the module and expects straightforward guidance or instructions for configuring or programming the hardware.
